details.jobDescription:
Alset is growing and we are looking for likeminded people, no matter the experience. From people with no experience to senior QA, as long as you want to work in video games in a growing, non-corporate environemnt, this might be the place to be.︁︀​︂︀︀​︁︂︉​︇︉

Job Requirements
Must Have:
  • English level B2+ (written and spoken)
  • Knowledge in using a PC
  • Clear and concise communication
  • Willingness to learn and develop professionally
  • Attention to details
  • Out of the box thinking
  • Team-oriented, respectful, and open to feedback
For more experienced people:
  • General understanding of the video game industry
  • Understanding of QA processes and terminology
  • Experience using bug-tracking tools (JIRA or similar)
  • Ability to write structured bug reports (severity, priority, steps to reproduce)
  • Familiarity with either Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
  • Beta testing experience - nice to have
The advantages that come with this position include:
  • A supportive and approachable team culture - We are not a corporation, communication is direct, collaboration is encouraged, asking questions and learning is part of everyday work.
  • Growth and development opportunities - As a growing company with expanding teams and new offices, we offer opportunities to grow your skills.
  • Clear mentorship and a culture built on trust and respect - Feedback is constructive, achievements are recognized, and teamwork is a core part of how we work. You will receive guidance from the project Leader and senior team members, that will help you understand expectations and improve steadily.

Your mission at Alset Studio
As a Game Tester, you will help to make sure games work properly by:
  • Testing different parts of the game to check that everything is working as expected
  • Finding, investigating, and reporting bugs related to specific components, such as visual, performance, stability, etc.
  • Following internal testing guidelines and workflows
  • Collaborate and communicate effectively with team members
  • Provide accurate feedback on gameplay and overall user experience
  • Respecting internal rules, processes, and security guidelines
  • Report progress and relevant observations to the QA Leader
  • Ensure the bug database is properly maintained and utilized

Alset Studio provides high-quality game services, including QA, Product Development, Art Production, and Player Support, partnering with studios on multi-platform experiences from development through live operations. Expanding from Belgrade, Serbia, Alset a new office in Bucharest, Romania in 2025. Join us to work on real game projects, apply industry standards, and grow with a company valuing integrity, teamwork, and a passion for games.
